ValidationRule.description: A plan needs its months and down payment, so the monthly instalments can be created. Use Create Instalment Plan on the opportunity: it fills these in.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Term_in_Months__c), ISCHANGED(Down_Payment_Percent__c), ISCHANGED(Down_Payment_Amount__c)), OR(ISBLANK(Term_in_Months__c), ISBLANK(Down_Payment_Percent__c), ISBLANK(Down_Payment_Amount__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter AM Term in Months, AM Down Payment % and AM Down Payment Amount. Tip: use the Create Instalment Plan button on the opportunity, which fills them in for you.
